summary: Universal digital card and medical board certificate recognizing 21 specified disabilities under RPwD Act 2016.

steps.title: Register on Swavlamban portal
steps.description: Submit personal details, disability type (locomotor, visual, hearing, intellectual, etc.), and address.

steps.title: Book medical assessment appointment
steps.description: System assigns date for evaluation at District Civil Hospital Medical Board.

steps.title: Medical board physical evaluation
steps.description: Panel of specialist doctors conducts tests and determines disability percentage (e.g. 40%+ benchmark disability).

steps.title: Download Disability Certificate
steps.description: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) signs digital certificate stating permanent/temporary disability percentage.

steps.title: Receive National UDID Smart Card
steps.description: Plastic UDID card with smart chip dispatched by speed post to home address.
